title: RFQ for Yanmar Boat Engines
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSUP.NAVSUP GLOBAL LOGISTICS SUPPORT.NAVSUP FLC NORFOLK.NAVSUP FLT LOG CTR NORFOLK
description_text: The United States Naval Academy (USNA) intends to procure four Yanmar engines part-number BOMG 4JH57 Engine, KM4A1 transmission, and four alternator kits. Please see Brand Name Justification and Solicitation for details.
